contentFindings: The first case uses a bag with permeable trace dye and impermeable salt; both initial net arrows point inward and are separately explained.

The second case uses a distinct two-chamber membrane with permeable trace urea and impermeable sucrose. Urea is higher outside and initially diffuses inward, while sucrose is much higher outside and water initially moves outward. This forces opposite arrows and separate reasoning, correcting the v4 variation HOLD.

Equal initial pressure and temperature, explicit permeability and a quantitatively negligible trace-solute contribution make both initial osmotic directions determinate. The DE and EN cases agree, stay within the current diffusion/osmosis goal, and do not claim long-term equilibrium or human approval.
